violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach (26 TAC §747.2104(a)(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: The home is not equipped with age-appropriate equipment for the children such as musical toys, blocks, trucks, dolls, shaking toys, rattlers, puzzles, etc.
